project.name: Bottify :: Application
project.description: Use cases and the PORTS that define the hexagon's boundary: - port/in : inbound ports = what the app can do (e.g. StreamTrack, ScanLibrary) - port/out : outbound ports = what the app needs (e.g. TrackRepository, AudioStorage, Transcoder) — implemented by the adapter modules - service : application services that orchestrate the domain via the ports Also framework-agnostic: no Spring here. Beans are wired in 'bootstrap'.
